cs.t: It works reasonably on my Dell Venue Pro with Windows Phone and IE, though there are a few glitches when long comment pages don't word wrap. But I've been using HN on my phone for almost two years. Having a hardware keyboard helps - my Nokia brick had one too.

I own a Dell Venue Pro which has both keyboard and touchsreen text entry. Autocorrect is counterproductive when I use the keyboard. I wouldn't even begin to want that in a word processor...or FireFox like I'm using now.
cs.th: Ask HN: Why is desktop text editing software still so bad?
